data.METRIC_CORRECTION: law of total variance: for an MSE-optimal predictor Var(l_hat)/Var(l_true) = 1 - MSE/Var(l_true), i.e. the P1 ratio EQUALS R2. The ratio target is R2, NOT 1 - a weak-but-honest predictor must sit low. Divergence between ratio and R2 is the real diagnostic
